title: 第四章 宝物之争 暗潮涌动第五章 群雄云集 驱鬼祭天
content_zh:
“你不知道，在你走的这十几天，杨城里出了许多怪事。首先是东厂番子四处抓捕郎中医师，弄得杨城人心惶惶。现在城中没有一个郎中敢上街抛头露面。还有大坏蛋余入海也来到了杨城。”妞妞边说边吐了口口水。
“余入海？就是那个陷害、诬杀正直大臣，滥用酷刑，让百姓敢怒不敢言的大太监余入海吗？”小虫子撰了撰拳头狠狠地说道。
（明朝年间，永乐十八年，明王朱棣下令建设东厂。最初是为了巩固政权，监督反叛，缉拿奸党。但是随着朝内*专横的滋长，宦官专权逐渐成为了明朝的一颗毒瘤。他们大多为了自身利益，铲除异己，横征暴敛。当时百姓有云“京师亡命，诓财挟仇，视干事者为窟穴”。明宣宗时期，东厂厂公余入海权高位重，在朝中祸害忠臣，在朝外荼毒百姓，百姓敢怒不敢言！）
“恩，是的。不多久，消息传出是万锦王中了邪气，得了一种怪病，遍体冰凉，哆嗦不止。卜卦师们都说是恶鬼缠身，游魂索命。为此，万锦王在城中大建驱鬼台，听说要驱鬼祭祀。”
“再后来，你也瞧见了”，妞妞一指街上三三两两游走的过往侠客说道“许许多多武林人士向杨城聚集，这几天进城的刀客剑侠更是数不胜数！”
“啊，的确很奇怪啊！”小虫子摸摸下巴，装着大人的样子思索起来，这是他最喜欢在小伙伴面前卖弄聪明的样子，谁让他是孩子王呢。“虫哥，听说万锦王驱鬼祭祀的时候要举办家宴呢！”“啊？”小虫子立马从刚才的思绪中挣脱出来，摆出一副馋相，追问道：“真的吗？”“哦，当然喽，烧鸡，花鹅，桂花鱼。。。”那个挂着鼻涕的小男孩一本正经的念叨起来，边念叨边偷眼向小虫子看去。小虫子沉浸在眼花缭乱的美味遐想中都愣神了！“虫哥、虫哥，我也想要。”“我也想吃啊！这几天都饿坏了！”。。。孩子们又开始了七嘴八舌。小虫子摸摸自己的肚皮问道：“什么时候祭祀家宴？”“明天中午！”孩子们齐声说道。小虫子眼睛咕噜噜地一转，随即点点头说道：“应该可以的。”
孩子们都瞪大了眼睛等着小虫子的答复，当他一说出“可以的”这三个字之后，孩子们便是一阵欢呼！
入夜，杨城郊外，鼓浪峰。
两条身影如同鬼魅一般立在峰顶。高处风大，呼啸不止。其中一位看上去就如同稻草人一般，举止机械。远远望去，你会以为那不是身形，只是一件会动的、漆黑的大斗篷在那里伫立着。风呼呼刮来，将其衣服掀起，令人惊奇的是它竟然没有双脚！而身体却立在那里！扣帽底下是一张面具，惨白色的脸、比例极不协调的大眼，转来转去。而下面是一张颜色艳丽涂抹的小嘴，搭配起来是那么地诡异。风再次扬起，扯起那件披风，你会发现，竟然，竟然，它连双手都没有！真的就像是活脱脱一个稻草人！而旁边另一位消瘦异常，大长脸，颚骨高高，扎一条长辫。穿着一件宽大疏松的黑色披风。左手藏在宽厚的袖筒里，不见五指。而右手微微探出长袖，露出褐色的、细长的指甲，真是如同干尸手指一般枯槁，尖锐。手中执着一盏灯，外罩本是透明的，或许是经过长久灯火熏燎的缘故，上面斑驳着厚厚的墨点。显得古朴，厚重。但是里面跳跃着的灯火却闪着怪异的青光，像是鬼火，忽明忽暗，飘摆不定。显然这是一件邪性的东西。
随着风声席卷，二人的对话慢慢传来。
“白玉观音？！此等事物果真存在？”提灯人问道。那个怪异的“稻草人”边转着两颗咕噜噜的大眼睛边阴晴不定的说道：“白玉观音，来源不明。但因其质地纤白若乳，似玉，故江湖人美名其曰：白玉观音。传言‘白玉观音’至阴至寒，可通经透络，强筋韧骨，益寿延年。任何没有武功的人吸取其精华，可以获得近百年修行。若是武功高兀遇到瓶颈、再无提升余地的人获之便如龙挣困锁、虎出荒野，武功修行不可同日而语！更为要紧的是“白玉观音”可能牵扯到一门失传的武功绝学——异蝶术！但是，放眼天下还无一人曾见过此物。以前我只当这是一个传说，所以在凌渊王亲口下达命令并且嘱咐我的时候，我便大吃一惊！”
“什么？‘白玉观音’现世了？！还有‘异蝶术’？传言中弑鬼杀神的武林秘术？难。。。怪！难，怪！”最后几个字，提灯人都开始哆哆嗦嗦了。
“嘘！”那位身披漆黑大斗篷的“稻草人”突然快速地向提灯黑衣人使了个眼色。提灯黑衣人迅速探出左手，中指快速地伸向闪着幽幽绿光的灯盏，一挑灯芯，一丝鬼火便跳跃指尖，随后屈指一弹。鬼火以迅雷不及掩耳的速度砸向土坡下的一方矮石。
只听“嘭”地一声，小小的鬼火爆裂开来，将矮石附近照了个透亮！火光中，一位衣着与黑衣斗篷相似，并且也配戴相同面具的人现身出来！只不过他低头捂着胸口，嘴角还渗着血丝，步履蹒跚地扶着一方矮石，正向两位黑衣人慢慢靠过来。
“鬼衣左使！鬼灯右使！”他抬起颤抖的双手伸向了那位衣着黑衣斗篷的“稻草人”。“稻草人”立马抢步上前，然后诡异地从空荡荡的斗篷下“变”出了两只手，扶住了这个年轻的黑衣人问道：“是谁？竟敢伤害我鬼衣族人！快说！”
“左使，恕属下无能，中了暗算！”“咳咳。。。”他揉了揉胸口接着说道：“我们一行六人已经把鬼煞令与书信在午夜子时亲手插在了万锦王枕边。但是前脚刚出门，后脚便被人盯上。一开始我们以为是万锦王的爪牙，没当回事，想在巷角解决他们。因为仅仅只有两人！但结果出人意料，兄弟们没几招便被那两个人擒下灭口。。。”
“放屁！”提着鬼灯的那位黑衣人厉声喝道：“我幽冥鬼府，高手辈出！即便是普通“鬼衣”放之当今武林也算的上是好手。而且，这次行动策划稳妥、周密，外围家犬早已被鬼衣左使与我二人牵制住，怎么可能还有外人出现？！”
“诶！哥”披着黑衣斗篷的鬼衣左使打断了他的话语，并且冲他摇摇头，然后转过头来疑惑地问道：“这两个人是什么人？你看清楚了吗？
content_en:
"You don't know, in the ten days since you left, many strange things happened in Yangcheng. First of all, Dongchang fans went around arresting doctors and doctors, which made people in Yangcheng panic. Now no doctor in the city dares to show his face on the streets. And the big bad guy Yu Ruhai also came to Yangcheng." Niu Niu spat as she spoke.
"Yu Ruhai? Is he the great eunuch Yu Ruhai who framed and falsely accused upright ministers, abused torture, and made the people dare not speak out?" Xiao Chongzi said with a fist.
(During the Ming Dynasty, in the eighteenth year of Yongle, Ming King Zhu Di ordered the construction of the East Factory. Initially, it was to consolidate power, supervise rebellions, and arrest traitors. However, with the growth of tyranny in the court, the eunuchs’ dictatorship gradually became a cancer in the Ming Dynasty. Most of them were for their own sake. In the Ming Dynasty, Emperor Xuanzong of the Ming Dynasty had a powerful position, and he harmed loyal ministers in the court and poisoned the people outside the court. The people dared not speak out!
"Well, yes. Not long after, the news came out that King Wanjin was possessed by evil spirits and suffered from a strange disease. His whole body was cold and he was shivering. The fortune-tellers said that evil spirits were haunting him and wandering souls were seeking his life. For this reason, King Wanjin built a large ghost exorcism platform in the city. He heard that he wanted to exorcise ghosts and offer sacrifices."
"Later, you also saw it," Niu Niu pointed to the passing knights walking in twos and threes on the street and said, "many martial arts people gathered in Yangcheng, and there are countless swordsmen and swordsmen who have entered the city in the past few days!"
"Ah, it is indeed strange!" Little Chongzi touched his chin and thought like an adult. This is his favorite way to show off his cleverness in front of his friends. Who makes him the king of children? "Brother Chong, I heard that King Wanjin will hold a family banquet when he is exorcising ghosts and offering sacrifices!" "Huh?" The little Chongzi immediately broke away from his thoughts, put on a greedy look, and asked: "Really?" "Oh, of course, roast chicken, goose, sweet-scented osmanthus fish..." The little boy with a snotty nose started to talk seriously, and while talking, he glanced at the little Chongzi. The little bug was so immersed in the dazzling reverie of delicious food that he was stunned! "Brother Chong, Brother Chong, I want it too." "I want to eat it too! I've been starving these days!" . . The children began to chatter again. The little insect touched his belly and asked: "When will the family feast be held?" "Tomorrow at noon!" the children said in unison. The little insect rolled his eyes, then nodded and said, "It should be okay."
The children opened their eyes wide and waited for the little insect's reply. As soon as he said the three words "yes", the children burst into cheers!
At night, on the outskirts of Yangcheng, Gulang Peak.
Two figures stood on the peak like ghosts. The wind was strong and howling high up there. One of them looked like a scarecrow and behaved mechanically. Looking from a distance, you would think that it was not a figure, but just a big, moving, dark cloak standing there. The wind blew and lifted its clothes. Surprisingly, it didn't have any legs! But the body is standing there! Under the buttoned hat is a mask, with a pale face and disproportionately large eyes that turn around. And underneath is a small mouth painted with bright colors, which looks so weird together. The wind rises again. Pull up the cloak, and you will find that it doesn't even have hands! Really like a scarecrow! The other person next to him was extremely thin, with a long face, high jawbones and a long braid. Wearing a loose black cloak. The left hand is hidden in the thick sleeve, and no fingers are visible. The right hand slightly poked out of the long sleeve, revealing brown, slender nails, which were as withered and sharp as the fingers of a mummy. He held a lamp in his hand. The outer cover was originally transparent, but perhaps because it had been burned by the lamp for a long time, it was mottled with thick ink spots. It looks simple and heavy. ButThe dancing lights above were shining with a strange green light, like will-o'-the-wisps, flickering on and off, swaying erratically. Obviously this is something evil.
As the wind swept across, the conversation between the two slowly spread.
"White Jade Guanyin?! Such things really exist?" asked the lantern holder. The weird "scarecrow" rolled his two big gurgling eyes and said uncertainly: "The origin of White Jade Guanyin is unknown. But because of its texture, which is as white as milk and jade-like, people in the world call it White Jade Guanyin. It is said that 'White Jade Guanyin' can clear the meridians and meridians, strengthen muscles and bones, and prolong life when it is cold to cold. Anyone without martial arts can absorb its essence and gain nearly a hundred years of practice. If one is highly skilled in martial arts, People who encounter bottlenecks and have no room for improvement are like dragons breaking out of their traps and tigers emerging from the wilderness. What's more, the "White Jade Guanyin" may involve a lost martial art - the alien butterfly technique! But no one in the world has ever seen this thing. In the past, I only thought it was a legend, so when King Lingyuan personally gave the order and told me, I was shocked! "
"What? The 'White Jade Guanyin' has appeared?! And the 'Alien Butterfly Technique'? The secret martial arts technique that is rumored to kill ghosts and gods? Difficult... Weird! Difficult, weird!" With the last few words, the lantern holder began to tremble.
"Hush!" The "scarecrow" wearing a big black cloak suddenly winked quickly at the man in black with the lantern. The man in black with the lantern quickly reached out his left hand, and quickly extended his middle finger to the lamp that was shining with a faint green light. When he picked up the wick, a trace of will-o'-the-wisp jumped on his fingertips, and then he flicked it with his finger. The will-o'-the-wisp hit a short stone at the bottom of the slope at lightning speed.
There was a "bang" sound, and a small will-o'-the-wisp exploded, illuminating the area near the short stone! In the light of the fire, a man wearing similar clothes and a black cloak and wearing the same mask appeared! It's just that he lowered his head and covered his chest, with bloodshot eyes still oozing from the corners of his mouth. He was holding on to a short stone while walking slowly towards the two men in black.
"Ghost Clothes on the left! Ghost Lantern on the right!" He raised his trembling hands and stretched out to the "scarecrow" wearing a black cloak. The "Scarecrow" immediately stepped forward, and then strangely "transformed" two hands from under his empty cloak, supported the young man in black and asked: "Who is it? How dare you hurt my Guiyi tribe! Say it!"
"Zuo Envoy, I apologize for my incompetence and being plotted!" "Ahem..." He rubbed his chest and continued: "The six of us have personally inserted the ghost order and the letter into King Wanjin's pillow at midnight. But as soon as we left the house, We were targeted on the back foot. At first we thought they were King Wanjin’s minions, so we didn’t take them seriously because there were only two of them!
"Fart!" The man in black holding the ghost lantern shouted sternly: "In our Netherworld Ghost Mansion, there are many masters! Even ordinary "Ghost Clothes" are considered to be experts in today's martial arts world. Moreover, this operation was well planned and thorough. The peripheral dogs have already been restrained by the left envoy of Ghost Clothes and me. How could there be any outsiders showing up?!"
"Hey! Brother" the ghost-clothed Zuo Shi wearing a black cloak interrupted him, shook his head at him, then turned around and asked in confusion: "Who are these two people? Did you see clearly?
